messages:
incidents-bot: INCIDENT: Elevated 5xx rate detected for inference-gateway.prod (svc=inference-gateway, metric=5xx_rate) - paging oncall

alice_oncall: seeing it on the dashboard, spike started ~3412345600, currently ~4.8% 5xx over 1m :eyes:

bob_sre: on call, joining. any recent deploys?

alice_oncall: no deploys in last 2 hours per deploy-bot. traffic shift to lb-pool-b ~10m ago though.

carla_runtime: I can tail the envoy stats on gateway nodes now. giving me a minute.

carla_runtime: quick tail: `curl -s http://gateway-01.internal/admin/stats | grep upstream_cx_total` shows lots of upstream 5xx and increased `cluster.inference-backend.request_retry` counters

bob_sre: retries + 5xx = retry amplification risk. can we disable retries at the LB layer?

alice_oncall: trying: `kubectl -n infra patch configmap gateway-envoy --patch '{"data":{"route_retry.enabled":"false"}}'`

alice_oncall: patch applied, reloading envoy config on gateway pool...

carla_runtime: after reload, initial stats: retries dropped ~90%, 5xx rate started to decline but still elevated. looks like some backend pods are returning 502s/timeouts.

bob_sre: check circuit breaker/ejection metrics. `envoy_admin: GET /clusters?format=json` shows `max_connections_reached` and `cx_destroy` spikes for cluster inference-backend-shard-7

carla_runtime: yeah shard-7 has high overflow, connections hitting highWatermark and ejecting. likely caused by backend latency spike + retry burst.

dave_prod: any customer-facing impact? SLAs?

erin_support: working through support queue. so far 2 customers reported increased errors in last 8 minutes, both high QPS users. estimating ~2-3% of total requests impacted, concentrated on shard-7 region-us-west.

bob_sre: mitigation plan: 1) keep retries off 2) temporarily reduce weight to shard-7 in LB to 5% 3) increase CB thresholds for shard-7 to avoid noisy ejection while we investigate 4) scale up inference-backend in that shard if needed.

alice_oncall: shifting traffic: `trafficctl set-weight --pool inference --shard shard-7 --weight 5`

alice_oncall: weight set, seeing immediate drop in errors from 4.8% -> 1.2% across global gateway within 60s.

carla_runtime: while weight is low, I'll roll new container on shard-7 with a minor env tweak (increase connection pool size) and check resource contention.

carla_runtime: `kubectl -n ml rollout restart deploy/inference-backend-shard-7` started. also kicked off a quick scale: `kubectl scale deploy/inference-backend-shard-7 --replicas=6`

bob_sre: good. I'll monitor ejection stats. If ejections stop and 5xx remains low, we can roll weight back up gradually.

alice_oncall: monitoring charts show error rate now trending to baseline ~0.4%. customer noise reduced. sending initial incident notification to pagerduty-ops.

erin_support: told impacted customers we saw transient LB/back-end errors, mitigation in progress, will follow up with RCA.

dave_prod: for post-incident: we need to validate retry policies are sensible (shadow test before global enable), add early-warning alert on `retry_rate > 1% and 5xx_rate rising` and add per-shard health rollup dashboard.

bob_sre: agreed. immediate follow-ups: - revert retry disable only after we can shadow/test - tune circuit-breaker to avoid aggressive ejection for short blips - add autoscale cushion for hot shards

alice_oncall: handing off to bob_sre for next 6 hours to lead post-incident tasks, I'm logging out. bob, you're primary. :wave:

bob_sre: taking handoff. I'll drive RCA and timeline. preliminary root cause hypothesis: traffic shift increased load on shard-7, backend latency spike caused retries to amplify load, CBs ejected hosts making remaining healthy hosts overwhelmed -> 5xx spike.

carla_runtime: collecting logs and pprof from shard-7 nodes, saving to s3://redwood-incidents/3412345678/ for RCA.

erin_support: updating support tickets and customers with mitigation summary.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: 5xx rate reduced to 0.35% after traffic shift and scale, status: mitigated, severity: SEV3, follow-up assigned to bob_sre.

bob_sre: thanks team. will post full RCA draft in #postmortems by EOD and follow up with runbook changes. anyone else want to add notes before I close thread?

alice_oncall: nope, thanks. good mitigation. :thumbsup:

carla_runtime: note: we should add a quick test to verify retry backoff behavior under partial outage, catching amplification patterns earlier.

bob_sre: noted. closing the active paging portion, leaving this thread for RCA comments.
